name: Automatic LED Strip Placing Machine
summary: Precisely and quickly place LED light strips at designated positions. Capable of picking up multiple strips at once, with pressure-holding function to ensure assembly accuracy.
contentHtml:
The automatic light bar placement machine uses a robotic unit to automate the placement of light bars.

Working Principle

Using a robot combined with a vision system, it can precisely grasp 7 light bars and place them at the target position at once. The equipment features a pressure-holding function to ensure the light bars are firmly secured.

Technical Advantages

  • Assembly precision ±0.2mm
  • Can grasp 7 light bars at once for high efficiency
  • Pressure-holding function ensures assembly quality
  • Supports CAD import for quick changeovers
